en.description: A Lean formalization of uniform length and total-curvature estimates for existing curve flows under Ricci flow.
en.pdf_detail: Mathematical account and formalization boundaries · English PDF
en.blueprint_detail: Statements, prerequisites, contributions and linked Lean declarations
en.main_title: Uniform estimates over static one-dimensional factors
en.main_link: Read the complete statement and its boundaries
en.scope_first: The formalization assumes an existing smooth, immersed, closed curve flow and proves the internal geometric evolution identities and analytic estimates controlling length and total curvature.
en.scope_second: The geometric quantities use the actual evolving metric. Uniform product bounds use constants obtained from the compact base geometry, independent of the static one-dimensional factor metric. Regularization is removed after comparison.
